description: This file defines a PHP class 'ViewDisplaydeployresult' that extends 'SugarView'. It is responsible for displaying deployment result messages, disabling most UI components, and triggering an asynchronous relationship rebuild.

classes.name: ViewDisplaydeployresult
classes.description: A view class responsible for displaying deployment results and triggering UI updates in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the view with UI components hidden or shown as necessary.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Provides parameters for the module title, translating and retrieving module-specific titles.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Outputs the deployment message and injects JavaScript to trigger a relationship rebuild asynchronously.
